sound.title: Sound
ftue.invite.title: First time playing?
ftue.invite.sub: Got a minute? We'll show you how to play!
ftue.step1.title: FLIP YOUR CARD, BEAT THEIRS!
ftue.step1.p1: Slam to flip your card face up, then land it over their face-down card to win.
ftue.step1.p2: Win 2 rounds to win the match!
ftue.step2.title: AIM YOUR SLAM!
ftue.step2.p1: Aim inside the black ring around your card. Closer means a stronger slam.
ftue.step2.p2: You can't slam directly on a card. Your hand wobbles a little too.
ftue.step2.touch: Drag to aim, release to slam.
ftue.step3.title: FACE UP BEATS FACE DOWN!
ftue.step3.p1: Your face-up card must cover at least half of their face-down card.
ftue.step3.p2: If their slam puts their card face down under your face-up card, you still win!
ftue.step3.p3: 3–4 players? Lose your card and you're out!
ftue.step4.title: DON'T KNOCK A CARD OFF!
ftue.step4.p1: Knock any card off the table and you're out right away!
ftue.step4.p2: Go easy near the edge. A hard slam could send a card flying.
ftue.step5.title: A FEW MORE TRICKS!
ftue.step5.p1: Wind can push cards off course. Try a flat slam or a tilted slam.
ftue.step5.p2: Pass this turn? Next turn, slam in the pink ring. You get 30 seconds per turn!
ftue.pointerGoal: Goal: flip your card face up and land it on an enemy's face-down card.
ftue.confirm.title: {name} is learning
ftue.confirm.body: They're on step {n}/{total}. Start now and they can finish during the match.
tip.label: TIP
tip.flipped: Face up! Get it over their face-down card!
tip.threat: Their card's face up nearby. Don't get covered!
tip.edge: Close to the edge! Go easy or it'll fly off!
tip.forced: You passed. Now slam inside the pink ring.
rules.title: 6 QUICK RULES!
rules.r1: Your face-up over their down = win
rules.r2: Their face-up over your down = lose
rules.r3: Knock any card off = you're out
rules.r4: Same side or just touching = play on
rules.r5: Just passed = slam inside the pink ring
rules.r6: Time's up = turn lost (on a must-slam turn, the game slams for you)
rules.r7: Time runs out twice in a row = out of the round
